{{Quote|Hey, buddy! What are you doing down here? I thought you were too grand for the likes of us in CoCo Town!|Dexter Jettster, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="WS" />}}
'''CoCo Town''', also known as '''CoCo District''', was a commercial district located in the upper levels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Notable locations in CoCo Town included [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], the [[CoCo Penitentiary]], the [[CoCo District Theatre]], [[Pom Plaza]], [[Pets' "N" Pieces]], [[Bithuband]], [[Dewback Inn]], and an archive building of the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]].

CoCo Town (short for '''Collective Commerce District''') was an upper level district full of exclusive stores, restaurants and old-style diners. Many of these establishments catered to the maintenance crews and support staff working in the upper levels, while more refined eateries served the wealthier citizens of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]]. Diners and canteens such as the one owned by [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] were frequented by spacers, freighter pilots and an array of beings, including the Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].

Many of the more fly-by-night cantinas in CoCo Town operated without trading licenses, and were fitted with [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] for quick getaways from the [[CoCo District Constabulary]].

Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], CoCo Town experienced a garbage collection crisis, which resulted in huge piles of trash being deposited in city streets and outside major buildings. This forced [[Skyroute D25D]]&mdash;connecting CoCo Town to the [[Boribos Prefecture|Boribos]] and [[Hirkenglade Prefecture]]s&mdash;to be detoured between [[Kansen Entrance]] and [[Trotus Exit]]. A new refuse launch port was constructed in the area to combat the growing accumulation of garbage.

CoCo Town was also the location where the infamous [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]] were invented in a medical laboratory. While the death sticks did not heavily influence CoCo Town, they did affect the underworld life, eventually prompting a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] article about the addiction issues.

CoCo Town had its own [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|edition]] of HoloNet News, a news network for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Coco_town_miniature.jpg|thumb|One of the miniatures used for the streets of CoCo Town in ''Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones'']]
The streets of CoCo Town as shown in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] were shot as miniatures in natural outdoor lighting.<ref name="ImageAttack">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/09/imageattack20030925.html|series=Image Attack|text=CoCo Town Streets}}</ref>
